observations: Two open-mouthed forms with visible tooth rows occupy the upper half — a smaller one at left with looping black outlines and orange-tan fill, a larger darker one at center with yellow-gold bands across its top.
A red heart outlined in red and pink sits in the lower right quadrant beside horizontal blue stripes; a red cup-like form appears lower left among yellow spiral marks.
Thin lines in blue, red, yellow, and white cross the grey-brown ground in all directions, with a wavy blue ribbon running across the lower middle third and a pink-magenta arc near the top edge.
reading: Two snarling open forms face outward, their tooth rows drawn in white against dark fills, while yellow-gold bands press across the upper center. The image reads as crowded — competing marks in every direction — yet those two focal mouths hold it together. A red heart in the lower right pulls against the noise above, offering something quieter without settling the conflict. The grey-brown ground carries the color without absorbing it.
contextAngle: Within the owned numbered family, nnxyz #5 sits between nnxyz #4 and nnxyz #6. nnxyz #4 uses a warm coral-pink ground with bold horizontal banding; this work shifts to a cooler grey-brown field while the tooth-row motif continues. nnxyz #6 moves toward a sparser tan-ground composition.
